visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with medium-length black hair and a grey t-shirt holds a close-up of a blueberry oatmeal bar. (2) In a bright indoor kitchen, hands pour fresh blueberries into a white pot on a stove, followed by water and lemon juice. The mixture is stirred as it boils down into a thick, dark purple jam. (3) In a glass bowl, dry rolled oats are combined with maple syrup, coconut oil, peanut butter, and a pinch of salt. Hands use a white spatula to stir the ingredients until they are fully coated and sticky. (4) The oatmeal mixture is pressed into a rectangular mold lined with white parchment paper using a metal spoon. A thick layer of the blueberry jam is spread evenly over the base, and then another layer of oatmeal is pressed on top to seal it. (5) The mold is placed inside a clean refrigerator. After chilling, a knife is used to cut the finished oatmeal bars on a wooden cutting board. (6) The man returns to the frame, holding the bar and breaking it in half to show the layered purple center. He takes a bite with a satisfied facial expression, gesturing with his hands as he describes the taste.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 不用烤箱就能做 藍莓流心派. (2) [Slogan]: 製作藍莓果醬 藍莓加水燉煮至稠化. (3) [Slogan]: 燕麥片、楓糖漿、椰子油 花生醬、鹽巴. (4) [Slogan]: 攪拌均勻填入模具. (5) [Slogan]: 鋪上藍莓果醬 再覆蓋一層燕麥. (6) [Slogan]: 冷藏兩小時即可享用. (7) [Subtitle]: 很好吃耶. (8) [Subtitle]: 有點像軟餅乾. (9) [Subtitle]: 咀嚼時感受到 花生包裹椰子油香氣. (10) [Subtitle]: 藍莓的酸味平衡甜味. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果草莓吃不完 可以把內餡換成草莓果醬. (12) [Subtitle]: 也會很好吃.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy acoustic guitar strumming and a cheerful drum beat. A male voice speaks enthusiastically, welcoming the audience. (2) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator describes the cooking process. Audible liquid splashes are heard as water is added to the pot, followed by the soft sound of stirring. (3) The rhythmic BGM continues as the narrator lists ingredients. The sound of a metal spoon scraping against a glass bowl provides a textured percussive layer to the mix. (4) A mechanical 'click' and 'thud' indicate the opening and closing of a refrigerator door. (5) A sharp, crisp sound of a knife cutting through a dense snack bar is clearly heard, emphasizing the texture of the finished product. (6) The voice returns with a high-pitched, joyful inflection, expressing satisfaction with the taste. The BGM swells slightly before fading out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a quick, accessible no-bake dessert recipe for 'Blueberry Lava Oatmeal Bars.' It captures the viewer's attention with a visually appealing final product, demonstrates the simple cooking steps using rapid editing and on-screen text, and concludes with a enthusiastic taste test to encourage replication.
